content_scope: Seven new documentation/metadata files only. Existing sources remain referenced at fixed commits, not duplicated or changed.

self_exclusion.reason: A file cannot include its own final bytes/hash without circularity. Its Git blob, bytes and SHA-256 are independently checked from the remote publication and reported in the final chat/verification receipt.

commit_self_reference: Final enclosing commit is not embedded in files it hashes; 40-character remote SHA and fixed links are reported in final chat. That remote tree fixes every file.

publication.record_status: Prepared before commit/push; not a claim of already completed publication.

boundary: No new scientific calculation/solver/optimization/simulation/implementation. No scientific result or approval/state/STOP changes. Mandatory STOP after publication verification.
